The document notes that this rapid expansion is currently constrained by grid capacity and permitting delays.

factual_claims.claim: Global data center electricity consumption was approximately 415 terawatt hours in 2024.
Data center electricity consumption is growing at a compound annual growth rate of 12% since 2017.
Global data center electricity consumption could reach 945 TWh by 2030.
A single query on an advanced generative AI model like ChatGPT required an estimated 2.9 watt-hours of electricity in 2024.
Data centers consumed about 4.4% of total U.S. electricity in 2023.
The U.S. AI sector alone will require 50 GW of new electric capacity by 2028 to maintain global AI leadership.
In 2023, data centers and other large energy users accounted for 21% of Ireland’s total national electricity demand.
China installed 357 GW of new wind and solar capacity in the first half of 2025.
The average wait time for a new large-scale grid connection is now between seven and 10 years.
Google reduced the median energy consumption per Gemini prompt by a factor of 33 between May 2024 and May 2025.
